title: The Support-At-Most-Five Pebbling Number of the Lemke Square Is 64
decided_scope: Every 64-pebble configuration supported on at most five vertices of the 64-vertex Cartesian square L box L of the 8-vertex Lemke graph reaches every target root
open_boundaries: Configurations on L box L with support size >= 6 and unrestricted Graham's pebbling conjecture
